title: Co-occurring Associated REtained concepts in Diffusion Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2606.24192v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unlearning has emerged as a key technique to mitigate harmful content generation in diffusion models. However, existing methods often remove not only the target concept, but also benign co-occurring concepts. As illustrated in Fig.1, unlearning nudity can unintentionally suppress the concept of person, preventing a model from generating images with person. We define these undesirably suppressed co-occurring concepts that must be preserved CARE (Co-occurring Associated REtained concepts). Then, we introduce the CARE score, a general metric that directly quantifies their preservation across unlearning tasks. With this foundation, we propose ReCARE (Robust erasure for CARE), a framework that explicitly safeguards CARE while erasing only the target concept. translated_title: 扩散模型遗忘中共同出现的关联保留概念
translated_abstract: 遗忘已成为减轻扩散模型中有害内容生成的关键技术。然而，现有方法往往不仅移除目标概念，还会意外抑制良性的共同出现概念。如图1所示，遗忘裸体内容可能会无意中抑制“人物”这一概念，导致模型无法生成包含人物的图像。我们将这些不希望被抑制且必须保留的共同出现概念定义为CARE（共同出现的关联保留概念）。接着，我们引入了CARE分数，这是一种通用指标，直接量化这些概念在不同遗忘任务中的保留程度。在此基础上，我们提出了ReCARE（针对CARE的稳健擦除框架），该框架在仅擦除目标概念的同时，明确保护CARE。ReCARE自动构建CARE集合，即从目标图像中提取的良性共同出现标记的精选词汇表，并在训练过程中利用这一词汇表。
tldr: 本文提出CARE分数和ReCARE框架，以在扩散模型遗忘中保护良性共同出现概念，避免意外抑制非目标概念。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the CARE score and ReCARE framework to protect benign co-occurring concepts during diffusion model unlearning, preventing unintended suppression of non-target concepts.
